acceptance_run.criteria: 3 deterministic seeds (1201, 3407, 5527) x 1,000,000 simulated operations per acceptance run; 0 violations of INV1-INV6 and SAF in the reported traces
acceptance_run.note: Executed as a committed evidence artifact (the research-plan probe runs a bounded 200k-op slice to stay within the 120 s probe cap; the full 1M acceptance run is reproducible from the same script).

limitations: Bounded trace is acceptance evidence, not a proof of arbitrary LLM behavior or production distributed consensus.
Model-to-implementation translations (TLA+/Alloy) remain design obligations; only the Python model was executed.
Simulation is a single-process model of declared semantics, not the production runtime.
Auditor is a process-separated role within one local environment, not an external human or independently operated model.
Liveness claims without a trace are explicitly labelled design obligations.
note: S1-004 authored + validated: bundle.json with 7 verified sources, 10 claims, 11 artifacts; invariant_simulation.py review-fixed (2 fail-open model bugs eliminated: CRASH-B outbox double-publish, end-of-seed unreceipted SAF); probes pass 0 violations; focused crash-replay exactly-once; 1M-op acceptance run committed. research-plan PASS is a research evaluation; it never sets Goal ACCEPTED (release gate only).
